existing_protocol.constraints: Long-only, no leverage, residual cash earns 0; terminal liquidation charged.
existing_protocol.factors: Market open-to-open; cross-sectional 20-day momentum top-minus-bottom (gross). Zero risk-free proxy.
existing_protocol.historical_llm: Historical numerical replay may remain contaminated by pretraining knowledge. Blinding is only a sensitivity test.
existing_protocol.interpretation: Regression intercept is unexplained return conditional on these factors, not proven skill or causal alpha.
existing_protocol.invalid_decision_policy: Reject invalid or failed model output, target cash at the next open, charge turnover, and count rejection. Never silently normalize weights.
existing_protocol.timing: Signal after close[t]; trade open[t+1]; mark open[t+2]. No same-close fills.

existing_source.scope: Unmodified source frozen for offline comparison; only pure numeric functions loaded by AST; no model/store/network execution

limitations: Existing momentum is 20-day positive momentum at 50% weight, rebalanced every five sessions; not SMA20/50.
Existing adjusted-price fractional exposure embeds distribution reinvestment and terminal liquidation; new ledger uses cash dividends, integer shares and no terminal sale.
Existing one-way cost 15bp differs from the sample's 5bp slippage plus $1 fee; differences are not isolated implementation error.
Existing source has no closed-trade PnL or win rate; unavailable values are not invented.
scope: Actual existing algorithm comparison; strategy differences are explicit
